apks.help: Open the free Patreon post (no pledge needed) and download unrealquest-0.1.0.apk. Then pick the file here.

inputs.label: Unreal Gold game folder
inputs.help: Your own Unreal Gold folder, for example from GOG or the free OldUnreal installer.

steps.text: Open Unreal Gold VR from Library > Unknown Sources. On the first start, use the welcome menu to find and select the Unreal Gold folder in Download.

notes: The APK is only on a free Patreon post. The guide also accepts a zip of the folder; qgp pushes the folder. The GOG install folder name and the detect file (System/Core.u, present in every Unreal Engine 1 game) are assumptions; detect does not tell Unreal Gold from other Unreal Engine 1 games. A player reports it runs with the GOG release.
